name: BLM RecQ like helicase
pathways: regulation of cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity

function.text: BLM encodes recQ-like DNA helicase BLM. Annotated molecular activities include helicase activity and ATP hydrolysis activity. It participates in regulation of cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity and DNA repair.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include Bloom syndrome (autosomal recessive). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.
